channel.title: SSbreakingHeadlines
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Bootleg weight-loss drug linked to 2 reported deaths?
item.description: The reports, though unverified, come as authorities increase efforts to curb illicit sales of the experimental weight-loss drug retatrutide.

item.title: Man stabs at least 8 in South Korean mall
item.description: Officials in Incheon, South Korea, report that a man stabbed at least eight people at a shopping mall.

item.title: Runaway goat finds new home
item.description: ABC News' Danny New reports on a goat that escaped and has now settled into a permanent home.

item.title: Michael Jordan jersey sells for record $14 million
item.description: A game-worn, autographed Michael Jordan jersey from the 1998 NBA Finals sold for a record $14 million, second only to Babe Ruth's 1932 World Series jersey.
